name: AkesoEDR
description: Proof-of-concept Endpoint Detection & Response agent for Windows x64, implementing kernel-mode telemetry, user-mode API hooking, YARA scanning, and a multi-layer detection engine.

name: AkesoSIEM
description: SIEM platform with Sigma correlation, MFA-secured console, command palette search, and integrated case management.

name: AkesoDLP
description: Endpoint DLP platform with Windows minifilter blocking, Hyperscan-accelerated content inspection, and a React management console.

name: AkesoAV
description: C/C++ antivirus engine with multi-method detection, plugged directly into the AkesoEDR kernel stack.

name: AkesoNDR
description: Proof-of-concept Network Detection & Response platform built in Go for network traffic analysis and threat detection.
